name: GRG Banking Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: GRG Banking Equipment Co., Ltd. is a global provider specializing in artificial intelligence-powered solutions for the financial self-service industry. The company's diverse offerings include a broad array of financial self-service hardware, such as cash dispensing and recycling units, full-featured automated teller machines (ATMs), retail point-of-sale dispensers, drive-through ATMs, and currency exchange terminals. They also provide dedicated deposit machines, video teller machines, and teller cash recyclers. Furthermore, GRG Banking supplies advanced cash sorting equipment, along with various modular components like cash accepting and dispensing units, banknote validators, modules for depositing cash and checks, and banknote recycling mechanisms. Complementing its hardware, the company delivers comprehensive software solutions, encompassing terminal applications, foundational components, and robust terminal management and security systems. Established in 1999, GRG Banking Equipment Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
